anchor: observed keyed item mean separately in each original college, assigned arm and item; fail if any anchor unavailable, even if no blanks
grid_units: delta = half_points/2; points on keyed 1..5 item scale
interpretation: conditional-mean candidate for D under stated mean restrictions; fractional predictions are expectations, not fabricated observed categories or MI draws
missing_mean: clip(anchor+delta_arm,1,5), for each unobserved item including wave and item nonresponse; observed values fixed
prior_knowledge: Current ordinary records, all previous units including Unit9 contrast/support and original World design descriptions known before this new freeze. Not blind preregistration. No complete/hidden/reveal records used to select grid, model or paths. Grid fixed before first Unit11 calculation.
reference_link: unavailable item conditional mean equals observed item mean in its college/assignment/item cell; delta=0 is a mean restriction, not an established MAR mechanism
support_check: extreme (control+4,offered-4) and opposite reproduce Unit9 realized-D logical bounds; no causal bound or CI replaced
target_context: B8-T02; sensitivity for realized assigned-score contrast D, distinct from finite causal effect
target_function: original college shares Nc/1219 times offered minus control completed mean of five keyed items; no uptake conditioning
tipping: first equality D=0 on continuous piecewise-linear adverse path t>=0; output defined flag, omit t key if absent; if D(0)<0 report already_nonpositive flag and no first_positive_to_zero tipping; equality alone is not significance or causal proof
uncertainty: none added: grid is not a confidence or posterior interval; anchor estimation, finite missing outcomes and assignment uncertainty remain separate
